paragraphs.heading: Parties
paragraphs.text: This Lease is made on 15 December 2025 between JOHN HARTLEY of Bracken Farm, Wickham (the "Landlord") and Brackenfield Solar Limited, a company registered in England and Wales (the "Tenant").

paragraphs.heading: Background
paragraphs.text: The Tenant intends to construct and operate a solar photovoltaic and battery storage facility on the Property.

paragraphs.heading: 1. The Property
paragraphs.text: The Property comprises Parcels 9, 10 and 11 as shown edged red on Plan 1 annexed to this Lease.

paragraphs.heading: 2. Rent
paragraphs.text: The Tenant shall pay a rent of £1,150 per hectare per annum, payable quarterly in advance.

paragraphs.heading: 3. Term
paragraphs.text: The Landlord lets the Property to the Tenant for a term of 35 years from and including 1 January 2026.

paragraphs.heading: 4. Use
paragraphs.text: The Tenant may use the Property for the generation, storage and export of electricity and for ancillary purposes.

paragraphs.heading: 5. Rent review
paragraphs.text: The rent shall be reviewed on every fifth anniversary of the start of the term in line with the Consumer Prices Index.

paragraphs.heading: 6. Assignment
paragraphs.text: The Tenant may assign the whole of this Lease with the consent of the Landlord, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld.

paragraphs.heading: 7. Reinstatement
paragraphs.text: At the end of the term the Tenant shall remove the solar and battery equipment and return the Property to agricultural use within twelve months.

paragraphs.heading: Execution
paragraphs.text: Signed by John Hartley as the Landlord in the presence of a witness.

paragraphs.heading: Execution
paragraphs.text: Signed for and on behalf of Brackenfield Solar Limited by a director.
